items.a: Monday to Saturday from 6 am to 8 pm, and Sunday from 7 am to 2 pm. Bank holidays and exceptional closures are announced in the banner at the top of the site.

items.q: How do I collect my parcel?
items.a: Come to the counter with the pickup code you received by text or email, and an ID. If someone collects it for you, they need the code, their own ID and, depending on the carrier, a signed authorisation.

items.q: How long will my parcel be kept?
items.a: The holding period depends on the carrier and is shown in your pickup message. After that, the parcel goes back to the sender: if in doubt, give us a call.
Yes, cards are accepted. For some regulated purchases (tobacco, games), ask at the counter whether there is a minimum amount.

items.q: Which games can I play here?
items.a: PMU horse racing bets and FDJ games: Loto, EuroMillions, scratch cards and sports betting. Gambling is forbidden to under-18s.

items.q: Can we book the bar for drinks or a birthday?
items.a: Let's talk about it. Send us a message with the contact form or call 03 22 51 75 50, and we'll see what we can do.

bar.description: Le Sulky, your bar-tabac in Salouël at 23 route de Rouen: coffee from 6 am, tobacco, PMU, FDJ and parcel pickup. A few minutes from Amiens.
bar.intro: At 23 route de Rouen, Le Sulky is the local bar-tabac for Salouël and the south-west of Amiens. We open at 6 am Monday to Saturday for the first coffee of the day, and on Sunday mornings until 2 pm.

sections.title: A real neighbourhood bar
sections.text: Here, people say hello. The owner and the manager know everyone's habits: the strong morning coffee, the paper put aside, the Quinté ticket. A local shop the way we like them, simple and friendly.

sections.title: Tobacco, games and services
sections.text: Tobacco and accessories, PMU horse racing bets, FDJ games, press and top-ups, and a pickup point for your parcels. All at the same counter.

sections.title: Easy to reach from Amiens
sections.text: Le Sulky is on the route de Rouen, the road linking Amiens and Salouël: handy on your way to and from work.

relais.h1: Your parcel pickup point in Salouël
relais.intro: Choose Le Sulky as your pickup point when you order online: your parcel waits for you at 23 route de Rouen, from 6 am to 8 pm Monday to Saturday and 7 am to 2 pm on Sundays.

sections.title: Collecting a parcel
sections.text: As soon as you get the notification that your parcel has arrived, drop by with your pickup code and an ID. We hand it over in seconds.

sections.title: Dropping off or returning a parcel
sections.text: Pack your parcel with the label paid online with the carrier, then leave it at the counter. Keep your proof of drop-off.

sections.title: Which carriers?
sections.text: To be confirmed: the parcel networks accepted at Le Sulky. In the meantime, give us a call to check before choosing the pickup point.
